title: Railway departures-board stats
description: Usage figures on a station departures board: a centred serif heading and grey line over a full-bleed grid of near-black split-flap cells, grey mono capitals for each name and white digits for its figure (one row each on desktops, name and figure on separate rows on phones). The characters flip down into place column by column as the board scrolls in, and the last digits keep flipping like a live counter.
notes: phones show each stat's short figure (falls back to the full one)
CSS only: the flip-in rides a view() timeline with a per-column offset; all motion is off with reduced motion
screen readers get a plain list; the cells are hidden from them
